chunks: It is narrated from Mu'āwiyah ibn 'Ammār, who said:
I asked Abū 'Abdillāh عليه السلام about the Day of the Greater Pilgrimage. He said, 'It is the Day of Sacrifice, and the lesser is the 'Umrah.'

key_terms.الْأَصْغَرُ: the lesser one, referring here to the lesser pilgrimage
key_terms.الْعُمْرَةُ: the minor pilgrimage performed outside the full rites of hajj
key_terms.يَوْمُ النَّحْرِ: the Day of Sacrifice, the day referred to as the Greater Pilgrimage
key_terms.يَوْمِ الْحَجِّ الْأَكْبَرِ: the Day of the Greater Pilgrimage, identified here as a specific day in hajj

ai.seo_question: What is meant by the Day of the Greater Pilgrimage in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies Yawm al-Hajj al-Akbar as the Day of Sacrifice during hajj. It also clarifies that the lesser pilgrimage refers to the 'Umrah, making the report relevant to the terminology and legal understanding of pilgrimage rites.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3041 - It is narrated from Mu'awiya ibn Ammar who said:
"I asked Abu Abdullah (as) about the Day of the Greater Pilgrimage (Yawm al-Hajj al-Akbar). He said, 'It is the Day of Sacrifice (Yawm al-Nahr), and the Lesser Pilgrimage (al-Asghar) is the Umrah.'"
